description: Source code for the MotionDetection plugin, implementing motion detection control and event handling within the WPEFramework platform.

classes.name: MotionDetection
classes.description: Class implementing motion detection control, event handling, and JSON-RPC interface within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: MotionDetection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MotionDetection plugin and registering RPC methods.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters RPC methods.

methods.name: getMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves list and info of available motion detectors.

methods.name: arm
methods.description: Arms a specified motion detector with a given mode.

methods.name: isarmed
methods.description: Checks if a specified motion detector is armed.

methods.name: setNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the no-motion period for a detector.

methods.name: getNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Gets the no-motion period for a detector.

methods.name: setSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity for a detector.

methods.name: getSensitivity
methods.description: Gets the current sensitivity setting of a detector.

methods.name: getLastMotionEventElapsedTime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the last motion event.

methods.name: setMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Sets active periods for motion events.

methods.name: getMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves active periods for motion events.

methods.name: onMotionEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked on motion detection event, sends notification and updates last event time.
